org.asynchttpclient.netty.channel

Class InfiniteSemaphore

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.concurrent.Semaphore
      • org.asynchttpclient.netty.channel.InfiniteSemaphore
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class InfiniteSemaphore
extends Semaphore
    A java.util.concurrent.Semaphore that always has Integer.Integer.MAX_VALUE free permits
    Author:
    Alex Maltinsky
